devdoc.details: Supersedes WhitelistPreIntentHook for new deposits. Configuration is keyed by (escrow, depositId) and persists if the deposit's orchestrator whitelist-hook slot is unset (whitelist paused) and later reattached (resumed). Membership is point-in-time admission authorization: removal does not invalidate already-signaled intents. TRUST MODEL: attaching a group delegates ongoing admission policy for the deposit to that group's controller set (current/future owner and resolver) — see AddressGroupRegistry.

params._groupIds: Group ids to attach (max MAX_GROUPS_PER_DEPOSIT attached in total).

validateSignalIntent((address,address,ui.details: Implementations should revert to reject the incoming intent.

devdoc.title: WhitelistPreIntentHookV2

addToWhitelist(address,uint256,address[].notice: Adds takers to a deposit's direct whitelist. Idempotent: already-whitelisted takers are skipped (no event).

attachGroups(address,uint256,uint256[]).notice: Attaches groups to a deposit. Idempotent: already-attached ids are skipped (no event). Validates each group exists in the registry (input validation only — not a trust guarantee about the group's governance).

detachGroups(address,uint256,uint256[]).notice: Detaches groups from a deposit. Idempotent: ids not currently attached are skipped (no event). Detachment does not invalidate already-signaled intents.

getAttachedGroups(address,uint256).notice: Returns all group ids attached to a deposit.

isAllowedTaker(address,uint256,address).notice: Full effective admission check — same semantics as validateSignalIntent without the orchestrator gate or revert.

isGroupAttached(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Returns whether a group is attached to a deposit.

isWhitelisted(address,uint256,address).notice: Returns whether a taker is on the deposit's direct whitelist (groups excluded).

removeFromWhitelist(address,uint256,addr.notice: Removes takers from a deposit's direct whitelist. Idempotent: absent takers are skipped (no event). Removal does not invalidate already-signaled intents.

validateSignalIntent((address,address,ui.notice: Called by the Orchestrator during signalIntent before state changes.

userdoc.notice: Unified whitelist hook: a taker may signal against a deposit when they are directly whitelisted OR a member of any attached AddressGroupRegistry group. Allow-only; no blocklist.
